```{r load packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# --------------------------------------------------
# Safe package installation and loading
# --------------------------------------------------

install_if_missing_cran <- function(pkg) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  )
}

install_if_missing_bioc <- function(pkg) {
  if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("BiocManager")
  }
  
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    BiocManager::install(pkg, ask = FALSE, update = TRUE)
  }
  
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  )
}

# CRAN packages

cran_packages <- c(

  "dplyr",
```

```{r determine significant proteisn AD vs CU, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define metadata columns to exclude
metadata_cols <- c(
  "Subject", "Gender", "Age.at.time.of.LP..yrs.", 
  "Pathology_group", "Dementia_group"
)

# Protein columns = numeric columns excluding metadata
protein_cols <- setdiff(
  names(protein_quants_sci_rep)[sapply(protein_quants_sci_rep, is.numeric)],
  metadata_cols
)

# Define groups
group <- protein_quants_sci_rep$Pathology_group
table(group)

# Initialize results data frame
results <- data.frame(
  Protein = protein_cols,
  t_stat = NA,
  p_value = NA,
  adj_p_value = NA,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# T-test (AD vs CU)
for (i in seq_along(protein_cols)) {
  protein <- protein_cols[i]
  ad_values <- protein_quants_sci_rep[[protein]][group == "AD"]
  cu_values <- protein_quants_sci_rep[[protein]][group == "CU"]
  
  test <- t.test(ad_values, cu_values)
  
  results$t_stat[i] <- test$statistic
  results$p_value[i] <- test$p.value
}

# Adjust p-values for multiple testing (FDR)
results$adj_p_value <- p.adjust(results$p_value, method = "fdr")

# Filter significant proteins (FDR < 0.05)
sig_proteins <- results[results$adj_p_value < 0.05, ]
sig_proteins <- sig_proteins[order(sig_proteins$adj_p_value), ]

# View top significant proteins
head(sig_proteins)

# Write significant proteins to CSV
write.csv(sig_proteins, "sig_proteins_ad_vs_cu.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r add direction and group means to significant proteins, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(dplyr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Add AD and CU mean abundance and direction
# --------------------------------------------------

sig_proteins_direction <- sig_proteins %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Mean_AD = mean(
      protein_quants_sci_rep[[Protein]][
        protein_quants_sci_rep$Pathology_group == "AD"
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Mean_CU = mean(
      protein_quants_sci_rep[[Protein]][
        protein_quants_sci_rep$Pathology_group == "CU"
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Mean_Difference_AD_minus_CU = Mean_AD - Mean_CU,

    Direction = case_when(
      Mean_Difference_AD_minus_CU > 0 ~ "Higher in AD",
      Mean_Difference_AD_minus_CU < 0 ~ "Lower in AD",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    Protein,
    Mean_AD,
    Mean_CU,
    Mean_Difference_AD_minus_CU,
    Direction,
    t_stat,
    p_value,
    adj_p_value
  ) %>%
  arrange(adj_p_value)

# --------------------------------------------------
# View results
# --------------------------------------------------

print(sig_proteins_direction)

# Number of significant proteins higher and lower in AD
direction_summary <- sig_proteins_direction %>%
  count(Direction, name = "Number_of_Proteins")

print(direction_summary)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Export
# --------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  sig_proteins_direction,
  "sig_proteins_ad_vs_cu_with_direction.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  direction_summary,
  "sig_proteins_ad_vs_cu_direction_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r heatmap of significant proteins, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)

sig_protein_names <- sig_proteins$Protein

# Dementia_group is retained as an annotation
heatmap_data <- protein_quants_sci_rep %>%
  filter(Pathology_group %in% c("AD", "CU"))

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_data %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(sig_protein_names)) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(heatmap_mat) <- heatmap_data$Subject
heatmap_mat <- t(heatmap_mat)

# Remove proteins that cannot be scaled
heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[
  apply(heatmap_mat, 1, function(x) {
    vals <- x[!is.na(x)]
    length(vals) > 1 && sd(vals) > 0
  }),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Impute missing values by protein mean
heatmap_mat <- t(apply(heatmap_mat, 1, function(x) {
  x[is.na(x)] <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x
}))

# Z-score proteins across AD/CU subjects
heatmap_scaled <- t(scale(t(heatmap_mat)))

# Annotation: no age, no gender
annotation_col <- heatmap_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject, Pathology_group, Dementia_group) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(annotation_col) <- annotation_col$Subject
annotation_col$Subject <- NULL

# Annotation: no age, no gender
annotation_col <- heatmap_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject, Pathology_group, Dementia_group) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(annotation_col) <- annotation_col$Subject
annotation_col$Subject <- NULL

annotation_col <- annotation_col[colnames(heatmap_scaled), , drop = FALSE]

# --------------------------------------------------
annotation_colors <- list(

  Pathology_group = c(
    AD = "#7B3294",   # purple
    CU = "#FFB6C1"    # blue
  ),

  Dementia_group = c(
    CU  = "#1B9E77",  # green
    MCI = "#74ADD1",  # orange
    DEM = "#FDAE61"   # red
  )
)

# Convert protein IDs to gene symbols for heatmap display
rownames(heatmap_scaled) <- sub("_.*$", "", rownames(heatmap_scaled))

# --------------------------------------------------
pheatmap(
  heatmap_scaled,
  scale = "none",

  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,

  clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  clustering_method = "average",

  treeheight_row = 0,
  treeheight_col = 0,

  annotation_col = annotation_col,

  # ADD THIS LINE
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,

  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,

  fontsize_row = 7,
  border_color = NA,

  main = "Significant Proteins: Pathology AD vs CU"
)
```

```{r heatmap of AD vs CU significant proteins within AD pathology group, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Significant proteins from the AD vs CU comparison
# --------------------------------------------------

sig_protein_names <- sig_proteins$Protein

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Retain the full AD + CU pathology cohort
#    This cohort is used to calculate z-scores
# --------------------------------------------------

heatmap_data_all <- protein_quants_sci_rep %>%
  filter(Pathology_group %in% c("AD", "CU")) %>%
  mutate(
    Subject = as.character(Subject)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create protein-by-subject matrix
# --------------------------------------------------

heatmap_mat_all <- heatmap_data_all %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(sig_protein_names)) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(heatmap_mat_all) <- heatmap_data_all$Subject

# Proteins as rows, subjects as columns
heatmap_mat_all <- t(heatmap_mat_all)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Remove proteins that cannot be standardized
# --------------------------------------------------

heatmap_mat_all <- heatmap_mat_all[
  apply(
    heatmap_mat_all,
    1,
    function(x) {
      observed_values <- x[!is.na(x)]

      length(observed_values) > 1 &&
        sd(observed_values) > 0
    }
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Impute missing values using each protein's mean
# --------------------------------------------------

heatmap_mat_all <- t(
  apply(
    heatmap_mat_all,
    1,
    function(x) {
      x[is.na(x)] <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      x
    }
  )
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Calculate protein-wise z-scores across the full
#    AD + CU pathology cohort
# --------------------------------------------------

heatmap_scaled_all <- t(scale(t(heatmap_mat_all)))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Convert protein IDs to gene symbols
# --------------------------------------------------

rownames(heatmap_scaled_all) <- sub(
  "_.*$",
  "",
  rownames(heatmap_scaled_all)
)

rownames(heatmap_scaled_all) <- make.unique(
  rownames(heatmap_scaled_all)
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Identify AD pathology subjects and retain all
#    dementia groups: CU, MCI, and DEM
# --------------------------------------------------

ad_subject_info <- heatmap_data_all %>%
  filter(
    Pathology_group == "AD",
    Dementia_group %in% c("CU", "MCI", "DEM")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Subject,
    Dementia_group
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    Dementia_group = factor(
      Dementia_group,
      levels = c("CU", "MCI", "DEM")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Dementia_group, Subject)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 9. Restrict displayed columns to AD pathology subjects
# --------------------------------------------------

ad_subjects <- ad_subject_info$Subject

heatmap_scaled_ad <- heatmap_scaled_all[
  ,
  ad_subjects,
  drop = FALSE
]

# --------------------------------------------------
# 10. Create column split for CU, MCI, and DEM
# --------------------------------------------------

column_split <- ad_subject_info$Dementia_group
names(column_split) <- ad_subject_info$Subject

column_split <- column_split[
  colnames(heatmap_scaled_ad)
]

column_split <- factor(
  column_split,
  levels = c("CU", "MCI", "DEM")
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 11. Define red-white-blue z-score color scale
# --------------------------------------------------

z_score_colors <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2, 0, 2),
  c("#313695", "white", "#D73027")
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 12. Draw heatmap
# --------------------------------------------------

heatmap_plot <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_scaled_ad,

  name = "Expression\nz-score",
  col = z_score_colors,

  # Split AD pathology subjects by dementia group
  column_split = column_split,

  # Preserve CU -> MCI -> DEM order
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,

  # Cluster subjects within each dementia group
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_columns = "pearson",
  clustering_method_columns = "average",

  # Cluster proteins across all displayed AD subjects
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_rows = "pearson",
  clustering_method_rows = "average",

  show_column_names = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,

  row_names_side = "right",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14),

  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = TRUE,

  row_dend_width = unit(12, "mm"),

  column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
  border = TRUE,

  column_title = c("CU", "MCI", "DEM"),

  column_title_gp = gpar(
    fontsize = 12,
    fontface = "bold"
  ),

  row_title = "Proteins significant in AD versus CU pathology",

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Expression\nz-score",
    at = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
  )
)

draw(
  heatmap_plot,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right"
)
```

```{r combine files for full significant protein list, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Extract UniProt IDs

pq_to_id <- function(x) {

  x <- toupper(x)

  rhs <- sub("^[^_]+_", "", x)

  if (identical(rhs, x) || rhs == "") {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  ids <- unlist(strsplit(rhs, ";"))

  ids <- trimws(ids)

  ids <- ids[ids != ""]

  ids <- ids[grepl(
    "^[OPQ][0-9][A-Z0-9]{3}[0-9]$|^[A-NR-Z][0-9][A-Z0-9]{3}[0-9]$|^A0A[0-9A-Z]{7}$",
    ids
  )]

  if (length(ids) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  paste(unique(ids), collapse = ";")
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# ALL proteins measured in ProteinQuant
# --------------------------------------------------

metadata_cols <- c(
  "Subject",
  "Gender",
  "Age.at.time.of.LP..yrs.",
  "Pathology_group",
  "Dementia_group"
)

proteinquant_all <- tibble(
  ProteinName = setdiff(names(protein_quants_sci_rep), metadata_cols)
) %>%
  mutate(
    UniProt = vapply(ProteinName, pq_to_id, character(1))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(UniProt)) %>%

  # Split proteins with multiple UniProt IDs
  separate_rows(UniProt, sep = ";") %>%

  distinct(UniProt, .keep_all = TRUE)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Significant proteins from ProteinQuant
# --------------------------------------------------

proteinquant_sig <- sig_proteins %>%
  mutate(
    ProteinName = Protein,
    UniProt = vapply(ProteinName, pq_to_id, character(1)),
    ProteinQuant_significant = TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(UniProt)) %>%

  # Split multi-UniProt proteins
  separate_rows(UniProt, sep = ";") %>%

  distinct(UniProt, .keep_all = TRUE)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Tijms proteins
# Assumes all proteins in Tijms are significant
# --------------------------------------------------

tijms_sig <- read_csv(
  "S Table 4, Tijms et al 2024.csv",
  skip = 3
) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    UniProt = toupper(uniprot),
    Tijms_significant = TRUE
  ) %>%
  select(UniProt, Tijms_significant) %>%
  distinct()

# --------------------------------------------------
# Keep Tijms proteins measurable in ProteinQuant
# --------------------------------------------------

tijms_measured_in_proteinquant <- proteinquant_all %>%
  inner_join(tijms_sig, by = "UniProt")

# --------------------------------------------------
# FINAL combined significant proteins
# --------------------------------------------------

selected_sig <- bind_rows(

  proteinquant_sig %>%
    mutate(
      Source = "ProteinQuant"
    ) %>%
    select(UniProt, ProteinName, Source),

  tijms_measured_in_proteinquant %>%
    mutate(
      Source = "Tijms"
    ) %>%
    select(UniProt, ProteinName, Source)

) %>%

  distinct(UniProt, .keep_all = TRUE)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Counts
# --------------------------------------------------

cat("Total combined significant proteins:", nrow(selected_sig), "\n")

# Export
write.csv(
  selected_sig,
  "ProteinQuant_Tijms_combined_Sig_Proteins.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

head(selected_sig)
```

```{r dynamic tree cut to cluster subjects, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(dynamicTreeCut)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Select significant protein features
# --------------------------------------------------

sig_feature_names <- selected_sig %>%
  pull(ProteinName) %>%
  unique()

sig_feature_names <- sig_feature_names[
  sig_feature_names %in% names(protein_quants_sci_rep)
]

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build AD-only subject matrix
# Rows = AD subjects, columns = significant proteins
# --------------------------------------------------

ad_subject_data <- protein_quants_sci_rep %>%
  filter(Pathology_group == "AD") %>%
  select(
    Subject,
    Dementia_group,
    all_of(sig_feature_names)
  )

ad_expr_mat <- ad_subject_data %>%
  select(all_of(sig_feature_names)) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(ad_expr_mat) <- ad_subject_data$Subject

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Impute missing values by protein mean
# --------------------------------------------------

ad_expr_mat <- apply(ad_expr_mat, 2, function(x) {
  x[is.na(x)] <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x
})

ad_expr_mat <- as.matrix(ad_expr_mat)
rownames(ad_expr_mat) <- ad_subject_data$Subject

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Remove proteins with zero variance across AD subjects
# --------------------------------------------------

ad_expr_mat <- ad_expr_mat[
  ,
  apply(ad_expr_mat, 2, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0),
  drop = FALSE
]

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Z-score proteins across AD subjects
# --------------------------------------------------

ad_expr_scaled <- scale(ad_expr_mat)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Cluster AD subjects
# --------------------------------------------------

subject_dist <- dist(ad_expr_scaled, method = "euclidean")

subject_tree <- hclust(
  subject_dist,
  method = "ward.D2"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Dynamic tree cut for AD subject clusters
# --------------------------------------------------

subject_clusters <- cutreeDynamic(
  dendro = subject_tree,
  distM = as.matrix(subject_dist),
  deepSplit = 2,
  pamRespectsDendro = FALSE,
  minClusterSize = 5
)

names(subject_clusters) <- rownames(ad_expr_scaled)

subject_cluster_df <- data.frame(
  Subject = names(subject_clusters),
  SubjectCluster = subject_clusters
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Subject cluster summary table
# --------------------------------------------------

subject_cluster_summary <- subject_cluster_df %>%
  count(SubjectCluster, name = "Number_of_Subjects") %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster)

print(subject_cluster_summary)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 9. Subject dendrogram with dynamic clusters
# --------------------------------------------------

n_subject_clusters <- length(unique(subject_clusters[subject_clusters > 0]))

plot(
  subject_tree,
  labels = FALSE,
  main = paste("AD subject clustering:", n_subject_clusters, "dynamic clusters"),
  xlab = "",
  ylab = "Height",
  sub = "",
  hang = 0.03
)

if (n_subject_clusters > 1) {
  rect.hclust(
    subject_tree,
    k = n_subject_clusters,
    border = 2:(n_subject_clusters + 1)
  )
}


# --------------------------------------------------
# 11. Export outputs
# --------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  subject_cluster_df,
  "AD_Subject_DynamicTreeCut_Clusters.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  subject_cluster_summary,
  "AD_Subject_DynamicTreeCut_Cluster_Summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r calculate centroid scores, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

top_n_per_cluster <- 50
driver_score_threshold <- 0.5

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Long expression table
# --------------------------------------------------

ad_expr_long <- as.data.frame(ad_expr_scaled) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Subject") %>%
  mutate(Subject = as.character(Subject)) %>%
  left_join(
    subject_cluster_df %>%
      mutate(Subject = as.character(Subject)),
    by = "Subject"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Subject, SubjectCluster),
    names_to = "ProteinName",
    values_to = "ScaledExpression"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Centroid expression per protein per cluster
# --------------------------------------------------

centroid_df <- ad_expr_long %>%
  group_by(SubjectCluster, ProteinName) %>%
  summarize(
    CentroidExpression = mean(ScaledExpression, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Centroid-ranked high/low drivers
# --------------------------------------------------

cluster_positive_drivers <- centroid_df %>%
  group_by(SubjectCluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(CentroidExpression), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n_per_cluster) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(DriverDirection = "High in cluster")

cluster_negative_drivers <- centroid_df %>%
  group_by(SubjectCluster) %>%
  arrange(CentroidExpression, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n_per_cluster) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(DriverDirection = "Low in cluster")

cluster_specific_drivers_centroid <- bind_rows(
  cluster_positive_drivers,
  cluster_negative_drivers
) %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster, DriverDirection, desc(abs(CentroidExpression)))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Differential driver scores:
#    cluster mean minus mean of all other AD clusters
# --------------------------------------------------

cluster_driver_scores <- centroid_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    OtherMean = mean(
      ad_expr_long$ScaledExpression[
        ad_expr_long$ProteinName == ProteinName &
          ad_expr_long$SubjectCluster != SubjectCluster
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    DriverScore = CentroidExpression - OtherMean,
    DriverDirection = case_when(
      DriverScore > 0 ~ "High in cluster vs others",
      DriverScore < 0 ~ "Low in cluster vs others",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(ClusterMean = CentroidExpression)

cluster_high_drivers <- cluster_driver_scores %>%
  filter(DriverScore >= driver_score_threshold) %>%
  group_by(SubjectCluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = DriverScore, n = top_n_per_cluster, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

cluster_low_drivers <- cluster_driver_scores %>%
  filter(DriverScore <= -driver_score_threshold) %>%
  group_by(SubjectCluster) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = DriverScore, n = top_n_per_cluster, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

cluster_specific_drivers <- bind_rows(
  cluster_high_drivers,
  cluster_low_drivers
) %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster, desc(abs(DriverScore)))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Reusable annotation helper
# --------------------------------------------------

annotate_protein_table <- function(df) {
  df_annotated <- df %>%
    mutate(UniProt = vapply(ProteinName, pq_to_id, character(1))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(UniProt)) %>%
    separate_rows(UniProt, sep = ";")
  
  annotation_df <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = unique(df_annotated$UniProt),
    columns = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL"),
    keytype = "UNIPROT"
  ) %>%
    distinct(UNIPROT, ENTREZID, SYMBOL)
  
  df_annotated %>%
    left_join(annotation_df, by = c("UniProt" = "UNIPROT")) %>%
    rename(
      ENTREZ = ENTREZID,
      GeneSymbol = SYMBOL
    )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Annotated centroid and differential drivers
# --------------------------------------------------

cluster_specific_drivers_with_entrez <- annotate_protein_table(
  cluster_specific_drivers_centroid
) %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster, DriverDirection, desc(abs(CentroidExpression)))

cluster_specific_drivers_annotated <- annotate_protein_table(
  cluster_specific_drivers
) %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster, desc(abs(DriverScore)))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Shared behavior table
# --------------------------------------------------

shared_cluster_behavior <- cluster_driver_scores %>%
  mutate(
    DirectionClass = case_when(
      DriverScore >= driver_score_threshold ~ "High",
      DriverScore <= -driver_score_threshold ~ "Low",
      TRUE ~ "Neutral"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(DirectionClass != "Neutral") %>%
  group_by(ProteinName, DirectionClass) %>%
  summarize(
    Clusters = paste(sort(unique(SubjectCluster)), collapse = ";"),
    Number_of_Clusters = n_distinct(SubjectCluster),
    MaxAbsDriverScore = max(abs(DriverScore), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Number_of_Clusters), desc(MaxAbsDriverScore))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Summaries
# --------------------------------------------------

centroid_driver_summary <- cluster_specific_drivers_with_entrez %>%
  count(SubjectCluster, DriverDirection, name = "Number_of_Driver_Rows") %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster, DriverDirection)

driver_summary <- cluster_specific_drivers_annotated %>%
  count(SubjectCluster, DriverDirection, name = "Number_of_Driver_Rows") %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster, DriverDirection)

print(centroid_driver_summary)
print(driver_summary)

print(head(cluster_specific_drivers_with_entrez, 30))
print(head(cluster_specific_drivers_annotated, 30))
```

```{r  determine defining (absolute) proteins using centroid}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Long expression table
# --------------------------------------------------

ad_expr_long <- as.data.frame(ad_expr_scaled) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Subject") %>%
  mutate(Subject = as.character(Subject)) %>%
  left_join(
    subject_cluster_df %>%
      mutate(Subject = as.character(Subject)),
    by = "Subject"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Subject, SubjectCluster),
    names_to = "ProteinName",
    values_to = "ScaledExpression"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Centroid-based protein scores per cluster
# --------------------------------------------------

centroid_driver_scores <- ad_expr_long %>%
  group_by(SubjectCluster, ProteinName) %>%
  summarize(
    CentroidScore = mean(ScaledExpression, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CentroidScore_abs = abs(CentroidScore),
    Regulation = case_when(
      CentroidScore > 0 ~ "Upregulated in cluster",
      CentroidScore < 0 ~ "Downregulated in cluster",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Add UniProt, ENTREZ, and GeneSymbol
# --------------------------------------------------

centroid_driver_scores_annotated <- centroid_driver_scores %>%
  mutate(
    UniProt = vapply(ProteinName, pq_to_id, character(1))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(UniProt)) %>%
  separate_rows(UniProt, sep = ";")

annotation_df <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = unique(centroid_driver_scores_annotated$UniProt),
  columns = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL"),
  keytype = "UNIPROT"
) %>%
  distinct(UNIPROT, ENTREZID, SYMBOL)

centroid_driver_scores_annotated <- centroid_driver_scores_annotated %>%
  left_join(
    annotation_df,
    by = c("UniProt" = "UNIPROT")
  ) %>%
  rename(
    ENTREZ = ENTREZID,
    GeneSymbol = SYMBOL
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Remove true duplicates per cluster
#    Keep ALL rows where ENTREZ is NA
# --------------------------------------------------

centroid_driver_scores_dedup <- centroid_driver_scores_annotated %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster, desc(CentroidScore_abs)) %>%
  group_by(SubjectCluster) %>%
  filter(
    is.na(ENTREZ) | !duplicated(ENTREZ)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Select top 20% AFTER deduplication
# --------------------------------------------------

top_20_percent_centroid_drivers <- centroid_driver_scores_dedup %>%
  group_by(SubjectCluster) %>%
  mutate(
    CentroidScore_percentile = percent_rank(CentroidScore_abs)
  ) %>%
  filter(CentroidScore_percentile >= 0.80) %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster, desc(CentroidScore_abs)) %>%
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Summary
# --------------------------------------------------

top_20_percent_centroid_summary <- top_20_percent_centroid_drivers %>%
  count(SubjectCluster, Regulation, name = "Number_of_Proteins") %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster, Regulation)

print(top_20_percent_centroid_summary)
print(head(top_20_percent_centroid_drivers, 30))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Export
# --------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  top_20_percent_centroid_drivers,
  "AD_Subject_Defining20Percent_Proteins.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  top_20_percent_centroid_summary,
  "AD_Subject_Defining20Percent_Proteins_Summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r fgsea with centroid score ranking, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(purrr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load MSigDB Hallmark pathways
# --------------------------------------------------

msig_hallmark <- msigdbr(
  species = "Homo sapiens",
  category = "H"
)

pathways_hallmark <- msig_hallmark %>%
  split(
    x = .$entrez_gene,
    f = .$gs_name
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Run FGSEA separately for each subject cluster
#    using signed CentroidScore as the ranking statistic
# --------------------------------------------------

cluster_ids <- sort(
  unique(centroid_driver_scores_annotated$SubjectCluster)
)

fgsea_results_list_centroid <- list()
fgsea_ranks_centroid <- list()

for (clust in cluster_ids) {

  cat("\nRunning CentroidScore FGSEA for Subject Cluster:", clust, "\n")

  cluster_ranked <- centroid_driver_scores_annotated %>%
    filter(
      SubjectCluster == clust,
      !is.na(ENTREZ),
      !is.na(CentroidScore)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ENTREZ = as.character(ENTREZ)
    ) %>%
    group_by(ENTREZ) %>%
    summarize(
      rank_stat = mean(CentroidScore, na.rm = TRUE),
      GeneSymbol = paste(unique(na.omit(GeneSymbol)), collapse = ";"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(rank_stat)) %>%
    distinct(ENTREZ, .keep_all = TRUE)

  ranks <- cluster_ranked$rank_stat
  names(ranks) <- cluster_ranked$ENTREZ
  ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

  fgsea_ranks_centroid[[paste0("Cluster_", clust)]] <- cluster_ranked %>%
    arrange(desc(rank_stat)) %>%
    mutate(SubjectCluster = clust)

  fgsea_res <- fgsea(
    pathways = pathways_hallmark,
    stats = ranks,
    minSize = 10,
    maxSize = 500,
    nperm = 10000
  )

  fgsea_res <- fgsea_res %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    mutate(
      SubjectCluster = clust
    )

  fgsea_results_list_centroid[[paste0("Cluster_", clust)]] <- fgsea_res
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Combine FGSEA results
# --------------------------------------------------

fgsea_results_combined_centroid <- bind_rows(
  fgsea_results_list_centroid
)

fgsea_ranks_centroid_df <- bind_rows(
  fgsea_ranks_centroid
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Significant pathways
# --------------------------------------------------

fgsea_sig_centroid <- fgsea_results_combined_centroid %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster, padj)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Top pathways per cluster
# --------------------------------------------------

top_fgsea_per_cluster_centroid <- fgsea_sig_centroid %>%
  group_by(SubjectCluster) %>%
  slice_min(
    order_by = padj,
    n = 10,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Convert leadingEdge ENTREZ IDs to Gene Symbols
# --------------------------------------------------

entrez_to_symbol_centroid <- centroid_driver_scores_annotated %>%
  select(ENTREZ, GeneSymbol) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(ENTREZ), !is.na(GeneSymbol)) %>%
  mutate(
    ENTREZ = as.character(ENTREZ)
  )

convert_leading_edge_centroid <- function(entrez_vec) {

  symbols <- entrez_to_symbol_centroid %>%
    filter(ENTREZ %in% as.character(entrez_vec)) %>%
    pull(GeneSymbol)

  paste(unique(symbols), collapse = ";")
}

fgsea_results_combined_centroid <- fgsea_results_combined_centroid %>%
  mutate(
    leadingEdgeSymbols = map_chr(
      leadingEdge,
      convert_leading_edge_centroid
    )
  )

fgsea_sig_centroid <- fgsea_sig_centroid %>%
  mutate(
    leadingEdgeSymbols = map_chr(
      leadingEdge,
      convert_leading_edge_centroid
    )
  )

top_fgsea_per_cluster_centroid <- top_fgsea_per_cluster_centroid %>%
  mutate(
    leadingEdgeSymbols = map_chr(
      leadingEdge,
      convert_leading_edge_centroid
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Export results
# --------------------------------------------------

fgsea_results_combined_centroid_export <- fgsea_results_combined_centroid %>%
  mutate(
    leadingEdge = sapply(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")
  )

fgsea_sig_centroid_export <- fgsea_sig_centroid %>%
  mutate(
    leadingEdge = sapply(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")
  )

top_fgsea_per_cluster_centroid_export <- top_fgsea_per_cluster_centroid %>%
  mutate(
    leadingEdge = sapply(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")
  )

write.csv(
  fgsea_results_combined_centroid_export,
  "FGSEA_CentroidScore_AllResults.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  fgsea_sig_centroid_export,
  "FGSEA_CentroidScore_SignificantResults.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  fgsea_ranks_centroid_df,
  "FGSEA_CentroidScore_RankedGenes.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Quick view
# --------------------------------------------------

print(
  fgsea_sig_centroid %>%
    select(
      SubjectCluster,
      pathway,
      NES,
      padj,
      leadingEdgeSymbols
    ) %>%
    head(50)
)

print(
  top_fgsea_per_cluster_centroid %>%
    select(
      SubjectCluster,
      pathway,
      NES,
      padj,
      leadingEdgeSymbols
    )
)
```

```{r fgsea_leading_edge_symbols_and_centroid_direction, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Assumes these already exist:
# top_fgsea_per_cluster
# centroid_driver_scores_annotated
# --------------------------------------------------

# 1. Create ENTREZ -> gene symbol + centroid regulation lookup
driver_lookup <- centroid_driver_scores_annotated %>%
  filter(!is.na(ENTREZ)) %>%
  mutate(
    ENTREZ = as.character(ENTREZ),
    CentroidScore = CentroidScore,
    Regulation = case_when(
      CentroidScore > 0 ~ "Upregulated in cluster",
      CentroidScore < 0 ~ "Downregulated in cluster",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    SubjectCluster,
    ENTREZ,
    GeneSymbol,
    CentroidScore,
    Regulation
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# 2. Expand leadingEdge genes into one row per pathway-gene
fgsea_leading_genes_long <- fgsea_sig_centroid %>%
  select(
    SubjectCluster,
    pathway,
    NES,
    padj,
    leadingEdge
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    leadingEdge = map(leadingEdge, as.character)
  ) %>%
  unnest_longer(
    leadingEdge,
    values_to = "ENTREZ"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ENTREZ = as.character(ENTREZ)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    driver_lookup,
    by = c("SubjectCluster", "ENTREZ")
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    SubjectCluster,
    padj,
    pathway,
    desc(abs(CentroidScore))
  )

# 3. Collapse back to one row per pathway with gene symbols and direction
fgsea_top_pathways_with_leading_symbols <- fgsea_leading_genes_long %>%
  group_by(
    SubjectCluster,
    pathway,
    NES,
    padj
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    LeadingGenes_ENTREZ = paste(unique(ENTREZ), collapse = ";"),
    LeadingGenes_Symbols = paste(unique(na.omit(GeneSymbol)), collapse = ";"),
    LeadingGenes_Upregulated = paste(
      unique(na.omit(GeneSymbol[Regulation == "Upregulated in cluster"])),
      collapse = ";"
    ),
    LeadingGenes_Downregulated = paste(
      unique(na.omit(GeneSymbol[Regulation == "Downregulated in cluster"])),
      collapse = ";"
    ),
    LeadingGene_Directions = paste(
      unique(na.omit(paste0(GeneSymbol, "=", Regulation))),
      collapse = ";"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster, padj)

# 4. View and export
print(
  fgsea_top_pathways_with_leading_symbols %>%
    select(
      SubjectCluster,
      pathway,
      NES,
      padj,
      LeadingGenes_Symbols,
      LeadingGenes_Upregulated,
      LeadingGenes_Downregulated
    )
)

write.csv(
  fgsea_leading_genes_long,
  "FGSEA_TopPathways_CentroidDirection.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  fgsea_top_pathways_with_leading_symbols,
  "FGSEA_TopPathwaysPerCluster_WithLeadingGeneSymbols.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r go standard enrichment with cluster specific drivers, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Standard GO enrichment / ORA
# Using cluster_specific_drivers_annotated
# High and low cluster-specific proteins tested separately
# --------------------------------------------------

go_driver_input <- cluster_specific_drivers_annotated %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ENTREZ),
    !is.na(SubjectCluster),
    DriverDirection %in% c(
      "High in cluster vs others",
      "Low in cluster vs others"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ENTREZ = as.character(ENTREZ),
    Direction = case_when(
      DriverDirection == "High in cluster vs others" ~ "High",
      DriverDirection == "Low in cluster vs others" ~ "Low"
    ),
    ClusterDirection = paste0("Cluster_", SubjectCluster, "_", Direction)
  ) %>%
  distinct(ClusterDirection, ENTREZ, .keep_all = TRUE)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Split genes into cluster-direction groups
# Example: Cluster_1_High, Cluster_1_Low, etc.
# --------------------------------------------------

go_gene_list <- split(
  go_driver_input$ENTREZ,
  go_driver_input$ClusterDirection
)

# Remove lists with too few genes for meaningful enrichment
go_gene_list <- go_gene_list[lengths(go_gene_list) >= 5]

# --------------------------------------------------
# Run GO Biological Process enrichment
# --------------------------------------------------

go_bp_cluster_drivers <- compareCluster(
  geneCluster = go_gene_list,
  fun = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType = "ENTREZID",
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.20,
  readable = TRUE
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Clean results table
# --------------------------------------------------

go_bp_cluster_drivers_df <- as.data.frame(go_bp_cluster_drivers) %>%
  separate(
    Cluster,
    into = c("ClusterLabel", "SubjectCluster", "Direction"),
    sep = "_",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    DriverDirection = case_when(
      Direction == "High" ~ "High in cluster vs others",
      Direction == "Low" ~ "Low in cluster vs others"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    SubjectCluster,
    Direction,
    DriverDirection,
    ID,
    Description,
    GeneRatio,
    BgRatio,
    pvalue,
    p.adjust,
    qvalue,
    geneID,
    Count
  ) %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(SubjectCluster), Direction, p.adjust)

# --------------------------------------------------
# View top GO terms per cluster/direction
# --------------------------------------------------

top_go_bp_cluster_drivers <- go_bp_cluster_drivers_df %>%
  group_by(SubjectCluster, Direction) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = p.adjust, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

print(top_go_bp_cluster_drivers)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Export
# --------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  go_bp_cluster_drivers_df,
  "GO_BP_StandardEnrichment_ClusterSpecificDrivers_AllResults.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  top_go_bp_cluster_drivers,
  "GO_BP_StandardEnrichment_ClusterSpecificDrivers_Top10.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Optional dotplot
# --------------------------------------------------

dotplot(
  go_bp_cluster_drivers,
  showCategory = 10,
  font.size = 8
) +
  ggtitle("GO Biological Process Enrichment: Cluster-Specific High and Low Drivers")
```

```{r centroid zscore heatmap, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(ComplexHeatmap)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Select top centroid-score proteins per cluster
# --------------------------------------------------

top_n_per_cluster <- 10

proteins_to_plot <- centroid_driver_scores_annotated %>%
  filter(!is.na(CentroidScore)) %>%
  group_by(SubjectCluster) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = abs(CentroidScore),
    n = top_n_per_cluster,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pull(ProteinName) %>%
  unique()

proteins_to_plot <- proteins_to_plot[
  proteins_to_plot %in% colnames(ad_expr_scaled)
]

stopifnot(length(proteins_to_plot) > 0)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Order subjects by cluster
# --------------------------------------------------

subject_order <- subject_cluster_df %>%
  mutate(
    Subject = as.character(Subject),
    SubjectCluster = factor(SubjectCluster)
  ) %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster) %>%
  pull(Subject)

subject_order <- subject_order[
  subject_order %in% rownames(ad_expr_scaled)
]

stopifnot(length(subject_order) > 0)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Build z-score heatmap matrix
# --------------------------------------------------

heatmap_mat <- ad_expr_scaled[
  subject_order,
  proteins_to_plot,
  drop = FALSE
]

heatmap_mat <- t(heatmap_mat)

# 4. Replace row labels with gene symbols
# --------------------------------------------------

protein_symbol_lookup <- centroid_driver_scores_annotated %>%
  select(ProteinName, GeneSymbol) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(ProteinName))

row_symbols <- protein_symbol_lookup$GeneSymbol[
  match(rownames(heatmap_mat), protein_symbol_lookup$ProteinName)
]

row_symbols[is.na(row_symbols) | row_symbols == ""] <-
  rownames(heatmap_mat)[is.na(row_symbols) | row_symbols == ""]

rownames(heatmap_mat) <- make.unique(row_symbols)


# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create column split by cluster
# --------------------------------------------------

subject_cluster_split <- subject_cluster_df %>%
  mutate(
    Subject = as.character(Subject),
    SubjectCluster = paste0("Cluster ", SubjectCluster)
  ) %>%
  filter(Subject %in% colnames(heatmap_mat)) %>%
  arrange(match(Subject, colnames(heatmap_mat))) %>%
  pull(SubjectCluster)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Color scale for z-scores
# --------------------------------------------------

heatmap_colors <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(-2, 0, 2),
  c("blue", "white", "red")
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Plot heatmap
# --------------------------------------------------

Heatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  name = "Expression\nz-score",
  col = heatmap_colors,

  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  column_split = subject_cluster_split,

  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,

  row_names_side = "left",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),

  column_title_gp = gpar(
    fontsize = 11,
    fontface = "bold"
  ),

  column_title_side = "top",

  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = TRUE,

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Expression\nz-score",
    at = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
  ),

  border = TRUE
)
```

```{r PCA graphs}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# --------------------------------------------------
# A. PCA of AD subjects
# Rows = subjects
# Columns = proteins
# --------------------------------------------------

subject_pca <- prcomp(
  ad_expr_scaled,
  center = FALSE,
  scale. = FALSE
)

subject_pca_df <- as.data.frame(subject_pca$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Subject") %>%

    subject_cluster_df %>%
      mutate(Subject = as.character(Subject)),
    by = "Subject"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SubjectCluster = factor(SubjectCluster)
  )

subject_var_explained <- round(
  100 * summary(subject_pca)$importance[2, 1:3],
  1
)

p_subject_pc1_pc2 <- ggplot(
  subject_pca_df,
  aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = PC2,
    color = SubjectCluster
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +

    linewidth = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.6,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "A. PCA of AD Subjects",
    subtitle = "Subjects clustered by significant protein expression",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", subject_var_explained[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", subject_var_explained[2], "%)"),
    color = "Subject Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 18
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 15
    ),
   legend.title = element_text(
    size = 18
  ),
  legend.text = element_text(
    size = 15
  ),
  legend.position = "right"
)

print(p_subject_pc1_pc2)

# --------------------------------------------------
# B. PCA of proteins
# Rows = proteins
# Columns = subjects
# --------------------------------------------------

protein_pca <- prcomp(
  t(ad_expr_scaled),
  center = FALSE,
  scale. = FALSE
)

protein_pca_df <- as.data.frame(protein_pca$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ProteinName")

protein_var_explained <- round(
  100 * summary(protein_pca)$importance[2, 1:3],
  1
)

# Assign each protein to the subject cluster where it has
# the strongest absolute centroid expression
protein_cluster_assignment <- cluster_driver_scores %>%
  group_by(ProteinName) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = abs(DriverScore),
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    ProteinName,
    StrongestSubjectCluster = factor(SubjectCluster),
    DriverScore,
    DriverDirection
  )

protein_pca_df <- protein_pca_df %>%
  left_join(
    protein_cluster_assignment,
    by = "ProteinName"
  )

p_protein_pc1_pc2 <- ggplot(
  protein_pca_df,
  aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = PC2,
    color = StrongestSubjectCluster
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "B. PCA of Proteins",
    subtitle = "Proteins colored by strongest associated subject cluster",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", protein_var_explained[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", protein_var_explained[2], "%)"),
    color = "Strongest Subject Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
  plot.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 18
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 18
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 15
    ),
   legend.title = element_text(
    size = 18
  ),
  legend.text = element_text(
    size = 15
  ),
  legend.position = "right"
)

print(p_protein_pc1_pc2)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Optional exports
# --------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  subject_pca_df,
  "AD_Subject_PCA_Coordinates.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  protein_pca_df,
  "AD_Protein_PCA_Coordinates.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r dementia group breakdown per cluster, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)

# Cluster composition by Dementia_group

cluster_dementia_df <- ad_subject_data %>%

  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SubjectCluster))

# Counts and percentages
cluster_dementia_summary <- cluster_dementia_df %>%
  count(SubjectCluster, Dementia_group, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(SubjectCluster) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_total = sum(n),
    percent = 100 * n / cluster_total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster, desc(n))

print(cluster_dementia_summary, n = Inf)

# Wide table
cluster_dementia_wide <- cluster_dementia_summary %>%
  select(SubjectCluster, Dementia_group, n, percent) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Dementia_group,
    values_from = c(n, percent),
    values_fill = 0
  )

print(cluster_dementia_wide, n = Inf)

# Dominant dementia group per cluster
dominant_dementia_by_cluster <- cluster_dementia_summary %>%
  group_by(SubjectCluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = percent, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    SubjectCluster,
    DominantDementiaGroup = Dementia_group,
    n,
    cluster_total,
    percent
  )

print(dominant_dementia_by_cluster, n = Inf)

# Bar plot
ggplot(cluster_dementia_summary,
       aes(x = factor(SubjectCluster), y = percent, fill = Dementia_group)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  labs(
    x = "Subject Cluster",
    y = "Percent of subjects",
    fill = "Dementia group",
  ) +
  theme_bw(
  base_size = 16,
  base_family = "Aptos"
)

# Export
write.csv(
  cluster_dementia_wide,
  "Cluster_DementiaGroup_Composition.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

```{r Fisher test for DEM vs MCI, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# --------------------------------------------------
# Fisher's exact tests for dementia-group enrichment
# --------------------------------------------------

clusters <- unique(cluster_dementia_df$SubjectCluster)
dementia_groups <- unique(cluster_dementia_df$Dementia_group)

fisher_results <- expand.grid(
  SubjectCluster = clusters,
  Dementia_group = dementia_groups,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    test = list({
      
      # 2 x 2 contingency table
      tab <- table(
        InCluster = cluster_dementia_df$SubjectCluster == SubjectCluster,
        InDementiaGroup = cluster_dementia_df$Dementia_group == Dementia_group
      )
      
      fisher.test(tab)
    }),
    
    Odds_Ratio = unname(test$estimate),
    p_value = test$p.value
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    SubjectCluster,
    Dementia_group,
    Odds_Ratio,
    p_value
  )

# Correct for testing multiple cluster/group combinations
fisher_results <- fisher_results %>%
  mutate(
    adj_p_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(adj_p_value)

print(fisher_results, n = Inf)

```

```{r heatmap of significant FGSEA pathways}

# ============================================================
# FGSEA SIGNIFICANTLY ENRICHED PATHWAYS — HEATMAP
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create FGSEA pathway dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fgsea_heatmap <- data.frame(

  Cluster = c(
    1, 1,
    2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2,
    3,
    4, 4, 4,
    5, 5, 5,
    6, 6, 6, 6
  ),

  Pathway = c(
    "Hypoxia",
    "Coagulation",

    "Coagulation",
    "Complement",
    "Glycolysis",
    "Xenobiotic Metabolism",
    "Apical Junction",
    "mTORC1 Signaling",

    "Coagulation",

    "Coagulation",
    "Xenobiotic Metabolism",
    "Complement",

    "Coagulation",
    "Complement",
    "Xenobiotic Metabolism",

    "EMT",
    "Apoptosis",
    "Coagulation",
    "Complement"
  ),

  NES = c(
     1.822912,
    -2.823680,

     3.247282,
     2.072079,
    -2.118690,
     2.226707,
    -2.052930,
    -1.839370,

    -2.672410,

    -3.293170,
    -2.480080,
    -2.133440,

     4.126371,
     1.782236,
     2.094819,

     2.475710,
     1.878532,
     1.686864,
     1.663394
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define pathway order
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pathway_order <- c(
  "Hypoxia",
  "Glycolysis",
  "mTORC1 Signaling",
  "Apical Junction",
  "Xenobiotic Metabolism",
  "Coagulation",
  "Complement",
  "EMT",
  "Apoptosis"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Expand to all pathway x cluster combinations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

heatmap_df <- expand_grid(
  Cluster = 1:6,
  Pathway = pathway_order
) %>%

  left_join(
    fgsea_heatmap,
    by = c("Cluster", "Pathway")
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    Cluster = factor(
      Cluster,
      levels = 1:6,
      labels = paste0("Cluster ", 1:6)
    ),

    Pathway = factor(
      Pathway,
      levels = pathway_order
    ),

    PlotStrength = NES
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    Pathway = forcats::fct_rev(Pathway)
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fgsea_pathway_heatmap <- ggplot(
  heatmap_df,
  aes(
    x = Cluster,
    y = Pathway,
    fill = PlotStrength
  )
) +

  geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "NES"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Pathways"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

  theme(

    # White plot and figure background
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    legend.key = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    # Remove axis lines/ticks around heatmap
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    # Main title
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    # Axis titles
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    # Axis labels
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),

    legend.position = "right"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Display heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fgsea_pathway_heatmap
```

```{R heatmap of top 15 GO Term Themes}
# ============================================================
# TOP 15 GO BIOLOGICAL PROCESS THEMES — HEATMAP
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load remapped GO theme data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

go_heatmap <- read.csv(
  "GO_BP_Top15_Themes_Heatmap_REMAPPED_v2.csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

heatmap_df <- go_heatmap %>%
  mutate(

    Cluster = factor(
      Cluster,
      levels = 1:6,
      labels = paste0("Cluster ", 1:6)
    ),

    Theme = factor(
      Theme,
      levels = unique(
        Theme[order(Theme_Rank)]
      )
    ),

    PlotStrength = Signed_NegLog10_FDR
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    Theme = forcats::fct_rev(Theme)
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Set legend limits
# ------------------------------------------------------------

legend_limit <- max(
  abs(heatmap_df$PlotStrength),
  na.rm = TRUE
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

go_top15_heatmap <- ggplot(
  heatmap_df,
  aes(
    x = Cluster,
    y = Theme,
    fill = PlotStrength
  )
) +

  geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-legend_limit, legend_limit),
    breaks = c(-legend_limit, legend_limit),
    labels = c(
      "Negative",
      "Positive"
    ),
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Enrichment"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "GO Term Themes"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

  theme(

    # White plot and figure background
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    legend.key = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    # Remove axis lines/ticks around heatmap
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    # Main title
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    # Axis titles
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),

    # Axis labels
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),

    # Legend
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(

    ),

    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r heatmaps for complement and coagulation proteins}
# ============================================================

# COAGULATION + COMPLEMENT

library(tidyverse)


# ============================================================
# 1. COAGULATION LEADING-EDGE DATA
# ============================================================

coagulation_fgsea <- tribble(
  ~Cluster, ~NES, ~padj, ~LeadingEdge,

  1, -2.823680, 0.036822,
  "A2M;APOA1;APOC1;APOC3;C1S;C2;C3;C8A;C8B;C8G;C9;CFB;CFD;CFH;CFI;CPB2;CPN1;F12;F13B;F2;F9;FGA;FGG;FN1;GSN;HRG;ITIH1;KLKB1;PLG;SERPINA1;SERPINC1;TF",

  2, 3.247282, 0.003556,
  "APOA1;APOC1;APOC3;C2;C3;C8A;C8B;C8G;C9;CFB;CFD;CFH;CFI;CPB2;CPN1;F10;F12;F13B;F2;F9;FGA;FGG;GSN;HRG;ITIH1;KLKB1;PLG;PROS1;SERPINA1;SERPINC1;SERPING1;TF",

  3, -2.672410, 0.035120,
  "APOA1;APOC1;APOC3;C2;C8A;C8B;C8G;CFB;CFI;CPB2;CPN1;CTSH;F12;F13B;F2;F9;FGA;FGG;HRG;ITIH1;KLKB1;PLG;SERPINC1",

  4, -3.293170, 0.003789,
  "APOA1;APOC1;APOC3;C2;C3;C8A;C8B;C8G;C9;CFB;CFH;CFI;CPB2;CPN1;F10;F12;F13B;F2;F9;FBN1;FGA;FGG;GSN;HRG;ITIH1;KLKB1;MMP2;PLG;PROS1;SERPINA1;SERPINC1;SERPING1;TF;TIMP1",

  5, 4.126371, 0.033333,
  "APOA1;APOC1;APOC3;C2;C3;C8A;C8B;C8G;C9;CFB;CFH;CFI;CPB2;CPN1;F10;F12;F13B;F2;F9;FGA;FGG;HRG;ITIH1;KLKB1;PLG;SERPINA1;SERPINC1;TF",

  6, 1.686864, 0.043341,
  "A2M;C1QA;C1R;C1S;C2;C3;C9;CFB;CFD;CFH;CFI;CPB2;CPQ;CTSB;FBN1;FN1;GSN;HTRA1;MMP2;PROS1;SERPINA1;SERPING1;SPARC;TIMP1"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Expand leading-edge genes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

coagulation_long <- coagulation_fgsea %>%
  separate_rows(
    LeadingEdge,
    sep = ";"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Protein = LeadingEdge
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Get all proteins appearing in any coagulation leading edge
# ------------------------------------------------------------

coagulation_proteins <- coagulation_long %>%
  distinct(Protein) %>%
  pull(Protein)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create complete protein x cluster matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------

coagulation_heatmap_df <- expand_grid(
  Protein = coagulation_proteins,
  Cluster = 1:6
) %>%

  left_join(
    coagulation_long %>%
      select(
        Cluster,
        Protein,
        NES,
        padj
      ),
    by = c(
      "Cluster",
      "Protein"
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    Cluster = factor(
      Cluster,
      levels = 1:6,
      labels = paste0("Cluster ", 1:6)
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Order proteins by how often they appear across clusters
# ------------------------------------------------------------

coagulation_order <- coagulation_heatmap_df %>%
  group_by(Protein) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Clusters = sum(!is.na(NES)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    N_Clusters,
    Protein
  ) %>%
  pull(Protein)


coagulation_heatmap_df <- coagulation_heatmap_df %>%
  mutate(
    Protein = factor(
      Protein,
      levels = coagulation_order
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Symmetric NES scale
# ------------------------------------------------------------

coag_limit <- max(
  abs(coagulation_heatmap_df$NES),
  na.rm = TRUE
)


# ============================================================
# 2. COAGULATION HEATMAP
# ============================================================

coagulation_heatmap <- ggplot(
  coagulation_heatmap_df,
  aes(
    x = Cluster,
    y = Protein,
    fill = NES
  )
) +

  geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-coag_limit, coag_limit),
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "NES"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Protein"
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12,
    base_family = "Aptos"
  ) +

  theme(

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    legend.key = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(

    ),

    legend.title = element_text(

      size = 11
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(

    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-complement_limit, complement_limit),
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "NES"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Protein"
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12,
    base_family = "Aptos"
  ) +

  theme(

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    legend.key = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),

    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),

    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),

    legend.position = "right"
  )


complement_heatmap
```

```{r EMT and Apoptosis Table}
library(gt)
library(dplyr)

# Create Cluster 6 EMT + Apoptosis table
drug_table2 <- data.frame(
  Theme = c(
    "Epithelial–Mesenchymal Transition + Apoptosis",
    "Epithelial–Mesenchymal Transition + Apoptosis",
    "Epithelial–Mesenchymal Transition + Apoptosis"
  ),
  `Drug Class` = c(
    "Kinetin-Ribosides",
    "PLK1 Inhibitor",
    "Translocator Protein"
  ),
  Compound = c(
    "BRD-K94325918",
    "BI-2536",
    "PK11195"
  ),
  Cluster = c(6, 6, 6),
  check.names = FALSE
)

drug_table2 %>%
  gt::gt() %>%

  # Put FGSEA theme at the very top
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md(
      "**Epithelial–mesenchymal transition + apoptosis-associated perturbations**"
    )
  ) %>%

  # We don't need Theme as a displayed column
  gt::cols_hide(
    columns = Theme
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_width(
    `Drug Class` ~ gt::px(285),
    Compound ~ gt::px(350),
    Cluster ~ gt::px(100)
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(`Drug Class`, Compound)
  ) %>%

  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = Cluster
  ) %>%

  # Column headers
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(
      weight = "bold"
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%

  # Style title
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(
      weight = "bold",
      size = gt::px(16),
      align = "left"
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_title(
      groups = "title"
    )
  ) %>%

  gt::tab_options(
    heading.background.color = "#F2F2F2",
    column_labels.background.color = "#E6E6E6",
    table.font.size = gt::px(12),
    data_row.padding = gt::px(8),

  )
```

#APPENDICES 

```{r Subject and Protein Table}
subject_cluster_demographics_proteins <- protein_quants_sci_rep %>%
  mutate(
    Subject = as.character(Subject)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    subject_cluster_df %>%
      mutate(Subject = as.character(Subject)),
    by = "Subject"
  ) %>%
  select(
    Subject,
    SubjectCluster,
    Age = Age.at.time.of.LP..yrs.,
    Gender,
    Dementia_group,
    Pathology_group,
    all_of(sig_feature_names)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = case_when(
      Gender == 0 ~ "Male",
      Gender == 1 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Gender)
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(SubjectCluster, Subject) %>%
  mutate(
    Subject = row_number()
  )

# Check
head(subject_cluster_demographics_proteins)

# Export
write.csv(
  subject_cluster_demographics_proteins,
  "Appendix_C_AD_Subject_Clusters_Demographics_Proteins.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
